info.title: SBS Service Observability API
info.description: Reviewed Community read-only operations views and operational health surfaces served by sbs-service. Collection failures are normally represented inside the versioned view envelope rather than as a non-2xx transport status.

tags.name: SBS views
tags.description: Read-only cluster, node, volume, maintenance, capacity, and reclaim views.

tags.name: Operations views
tags.description: Membership, operation, query, MCP, GUI, and workflow views.

get.description: Returns 503 while the process is not locally ready or, when leader election is configured, while it is not mutation-ready. Dependency loss is reported separately by /dependency.
get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service local readiness and leader lease

get.description: Always returns HTTP 200. Dependency state and the fail-open serving/fail-closed mutation behavior are carried in the JSON body.

get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service runtime, cluster metadata, and maintenance workers

get.summary: Read the bounded SBS fleet aggregate
get.description: The normal polling route returns a shard-derived aggregate directly rather than wrapping it in View.data. It does not enumerate node, volume, placement, transition, or operation records, and stale or partial projections never trigger legacy full completion.
get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service cluster-summary, membership-health, and signed fleet-control projections
get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; missing, stale, partial, or rebuild-required projections remain typed and fail closed without a legacy scan fallback

get.summary: Read one revision-pinned SBS node page
get.description: Returns one bounded membership-projection page. The server never follows next_page_token automatically.
get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; bounded collectors may report a partial or degraded view

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque token binding the cursor, projection revision, and include_tombstones filter.

get.summary: Read one SBS node and its bounded store-health detail
get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service membership and node-health point records

get.summary: Read one revision-pinned SBS volume page
get.description: Returns one bounded volume-catalog page. Filters are bound into the opaque token and the server never follows next_page_token automatically.
get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; bounded collectors may report a partial or degraded view

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque token binding the cursor, catalog revision, and filters.

get.summary: Read one SBS volume state/spec detail
get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service volume state and specification point records

get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; bounded collectors may report a partial or degraded view

get.x-namrbd-authority: sbs-service volume metadata and sbs-data store health
get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; bounded collectors may report a partial or degraded view

get.summary: Describe the registered read-only query surface

get.x-namrbd-feature-gate: always; the response describes GUI capability and does not claim a public GUI

HealthOK.description: The process is alive or ready.

NotReady.description: The process is not locally ready or is not leader-ready.

PrometheusMetrics.description: Prometheus text exposition for readiness, leadership, TiKV requests, internal RPC classes, maintenance, capacity, and reclaim state.

NodeView.description: Versioned point view for one node and its available store-health record.

VolumeView.description: Versioned point view for one volume state/spec record.

PhaseADViewError.description: Versioned fail-closed error view. data.error explains the rejected page, token, filter, or point lookup and automatic_page_completion remains false.

ViewEnvelope.description: The fixed metadata from observability.View. data is selected per route and remains open to avoid overstating map-assembled response closure.

Snapshot.description: observability.Snapshot. Optional fields follow Go omitempty behavior; the object remains open for compatible observability additions.

FleetSummary.description: Identifier-free fleet counts suitable for the normal polling path.
